headline: Microsoft issues hotfix for Excel copy-and-paste broken by September update
summary: Both reports say Microsoft has released a fix for the copy-and-paste failures its September 2026 Excel security update caused, and both say the fix covers Excel 2016. They differ on how complete it is: one presents the issue as fixed, the other reports the hotfix as partial and says it may still fail around conditional formatting.
